caption: The drawing depicts a large crucifix featuring a central figure nailed to a cross. The cross is outlined in red and black with yellow ends and features geometric patterns. The central figure is adorned in a multi-colored, ornamented garment with dominant hues of red, black, green, and cream. The figure’s arms are outstretched, hands nailed, and a beard and mustache are visible on the face. Below the cross, there are seven smaller, standing human figures positioned in a row. Each one has distinct clothing, including hats, long gowns, and one with a drum. The color palette for these figures includes shades of red, brown, pink, black, tan, and blue, and the details in the clothing feature simple lines and patterns. The entire composition is set against a plain, cream-colored background.
title: Plate 29: Saint Acacius: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
